subject: Add option: Open all selected connections with Enter
body:
Add option: Open all selected connections with Enter

Introduces a new user setting and registry entry to allow opening all selected connections in the connection tree by pressing Enter. Updates the options UI to include a checkbox for this feature, with localization and layout adjustments. Connection tree logic now supports opening multiple connections or direct child connections of selected folders when the setting is enabled, while preserving original behavior if disabled. Adds a helper method and comprehensive unit tests for retrieving direct child connections. Updates resources, settings, and assembly version. Suppresses Enter key beep in the connection tree. The new behavior is opt-in and disabled by default.

security_flags.reason: added file has no reviewable text diff

triage.rationale: Multi-select Connect already works via the context menu; Enter still opens one node. Reimplement atop GetSelectedNodes and ConnectionInitiator; discard divergent folder logic and GUI-only wrapper.

votes.concern: The seven pump-less WinForms tests can deadlock or flake in the headless suite, violating this fork's established UI-test harness.
votes.reason: The feature is useful, but this patch bypasses existing multi-selection/opening logic, adds obsolete artifacts, and requires a focused reimplementation for current architecture.

votes.concern: Enter multi-open can mass-launch sessions; diff also bumps AssemblyInfo.
votes.reason: Low-priority UX, not core stability work; skip or rewrite without version noise.
